# United Athila Dhanori

> United Athila, Dhanori by United Landmarks LLP: 2, 2.5 and 3 BHK flats in Dhanori, Pune, from ₹84.58 Lakh. A pre-launch preview shared with selected clients and channel partners; it is not an offer or contract. Prices, areas and offers are subject to change; verify RERA (PM1260002602534) on MahaRERA.
